narrative: HCLTech leading Sarvam's $234 million first close at a $1.5 billion valuation mints a sovereign-AI unicorn on a domestic IT-services strategic check, not a Western VC, while Gartner's roughly 139% surge in agent-software spend gives national incumbents the demand signal to bankroll in-country builders. That template is exactly the structure the thesis expects a second market to replicate.
remaining_gap: No second sovereign-AI champion in a distinct market has crossed the $1 billion threshold on the same domestic-strategic structure.
